title: Quantum walks and graph operations
summary: Let $U_X(t)$ be the transition matrix of a quantum walk on a graph $X$ relative to its adjacency matrix $A$ or the Laplacian matrix $L$. This paper investigates the behavior of quantum walks under Cartesian products, joins, and graph complements. We have two main goals. First, we characterize the conditions such that peak state transfer and pretty good state transfer are preserved under these operations, allowing us to construct new families of graphs admitting these properties.
